CustomField.description: The correlation ID shared with the React/NestJS platform, so one identifier spans both systems' logs. Nebula's own TransactionId__c identifies a Salesforce transaction; it cannot identify the caller's request. Nebula copies same-named custom fields from LogEntryEvent__e onto LogEntry__c automatically, which is why the two carry the same API name. External Id so support can query by it.
CustomField.label: Correlation Id
